rules.rule: Set the `external-dns.alpha.kubernetes.io/controller` annotation to `dns-controller` on HTTPRoutes; never use `internal` or `external` there, since that causes external-dns to silently skip the route.

rules.quote: DNSEndpoints use `internal` (adguard) or `external` (cloudflare)
rules.rule: Set the `external-dns.alpha.kubernetes.io/controller` annotation to `internal` on DNSEndpoints that should go to AdGuard, and to `external` on DNSEndpoints that should go to Cloudflare.

rules.quote: restart it after changing node nameservers
rules.rule: Restart the CoreDNS deployment after changing the node nameservers, because CoreDNS reads node resolvers only at pod start.

rules.quote: Deleting the coredns Deployment before its Argo app exists deadlocks ArgoCD.
rules.rule: Do not delete the coredns Deployment before its corresponding Argo app exists, because doing so deadlocks ArgoCD.

rules.quote: do not propose `-np 2`, a prompt cache above 640 MiB, or a hybrid model (Qwen3.5/3.6, LFM, Granite) on nv1 without re-running the harness and the memory test
rules.rule: Do not propose running nv1 with `-np 2` without re-running the corruption harness and the memory test first.

rules.quote: do not propose `-np 2`, a prompt cache above 640 MiB, or a hybrid model (Qwen3.5/3.6, LFM, Granite) on nv1 without re-running the harness and the memory test
rules.rule: Do not propose a prompt cache above 640 MiB on nv1 without re-running the corruption harness and the memory test first.

rules.quote: do not propose `-np 2`, a prompt cache above 640 MiB, or a hybrid model (Qwen3.5/3.6, LFM, Granite) on nv1 without re-running the harness and the memory test
rules.rule: Do not propose a hybrid model (Qwen3.5/3.6, LFM, Granite) on nv1 without re-running the corruption harness and the memory test first.

rules.quote: wrap remote commands in `timeout -s KILL`
rules.rule: Wrap remote commands in `timeout -s KILL`.

rules.quote: avoid the `file`/`terminal` toolsets (SSH to a remote host)
rules.rule: Avoid the `file` and `terminal` toolsets when working over SSH to a remote host.

rules.quote: watch node `MemAvailable` (`talosctl read /proc/meminfo`), never `kubectl top`
rules.rule: Monitor GPU memory headroom by watching node `MemAvailable` via `talosctl read /proc/meminfo`.

rules.quote: never `kubectl top`
rules.rule: Never use `kubectl top` to check GPU memory on this unified-memory board.

rules.quote: after any Hermes model/provider change, run `kubectl exec -n hermes-agent deploy/hermes-agent -c hermes-agent -- hermes chat -q "ping"` before calling it done
rules.rule: After any Hermes model or provider change, run `kubectl exec -n hermes-agent deploy/hermes-agent -c hermes-agent -- hermes chat -q "ping"` and confirm it succeeds before declaring the change done.

rules.quote: a rollback must overwrite `base_url`/`api_key`/`context_length` explicitly
rules.rule: When rolling back a Hermes model or provider change, explicitly overwrite `base_url`, `api_key`, and `context_length` rather than relying on the seeders, which only add keys.

rules.quote: A local Hermes main model needs `ctx / parallel >= 64000`
rules.rule: Configure a local Hermes main model so that llama-server context divided by parallel slots is at least 64000.

rules.quote: more slots need `ctx / parallel >= 64000`
rules.rule: When adding llama-server parallel slots, keep context divided by parallel slots at least 64000.

rules.quote: The floor still applies to any model a profile or auxiliary task uses.
rules.rule: Ensure any model used by a Hermes profile or auxiliary task has a context window of at least 64,000 tokens.

rules.quote: if a GPU image aborts on JIT, check that `libnvidia-ptxjitcompiler.so.1` is in `/var/lib/nvidia-tegra-libs/tegra`
rules.rule: When a GPU image aborts with a PTX JIT error, check that libnvidia-ptxjitcompiler.so.1 is present in /var/lib/nvidia-tegra-libs/tegra.

rules.quote: After any image bump check `ggml_cuda_init: found 1 CUDA devices`
rules.rule: After any llama image bump, check the startup log for the line `ggml_cuda_init: found 1 CUDA devices`.

rules.quote: and the offload line in the startup log
rules.rule: After any llama image bump, check the offload line in the startup log.

rules.quote: add the internal route too
rules.rule: When adding or reviewing an internet-exposed app that moves large data (files, photos, media), also add a second HTTPRoute for the same host attached to the envoy-internal gateway.

rules.quote: Check it with `nslookup` on the client
rules.rule: To verify a hostname's DNS resolution after a route change, run nslookup on the client device on the LAN, not in the dev container, which resolves differently.

rules.quote: Do not set `LOCAL_AI_API_KEY` (or `_FILE`) in `cluster/apps/media/lingarr/values.yaml`
rules.rule: Do not set LOCAL_AI_API_KEY (or LOCAL_AI_API_KEY_FILE) in cluster/apps/media/lingarr/values.yaml.

rules.quote: Reading `local.db` for checks: copy `local.db`, `-wal` and `-shm` together, or the result is stale
rules.rule: When reading Lingarr's local.db for checks, copy local.db, its -wal and -shm files together rather than reading the database in place.

rules.quote: print lengths and shape only, never the key
rules.rule: When inspecting Lingarr's local.db, print only the lengths and shape of key values, never the key itself.

rules.quote: so its settings API needs a login; use the UI.
rules.rule: Do not use Lingarr's settings API to change settings, since it requires login; make settings changes through the UI instead.

rules.quote: Avoid `pkill -f`/`pgrep -f ... | kill` in Bash tool commands
rules.rule: Avoid `pkill -f` and `pgrep -f ... | kill` in Bash tool commands, because the pattern matches the tool's own shell.

rules.quote: List PIDs with `ps` and kill by number.
rules.rule: When killing a process, list its PID with `ps` and kill it by number.

rules.quote: requests opt in with `chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=true`
rules.rule: To enable thinking for a Gemma 4 llama-server request, set `chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=true` in that request.

rules.quote: re-check pod working set and node `MemAvailable` (`talosctl -n 192.168.48.5 read /proc/meminfo`) under a sustained multi-prompt test, not just a single request
rules.rule: Before changing llama-server memory flags, quantization, context, or parallel slots, re-check the pod working set and node MemAvailable under a sustained multi-prompt test, not just a single request.

rules.quote: watch node `MemAvailable`
rules.rule: Watch node MemAvailable when running llama-server on the nv1 node.

rules.quote: cap `--cache-ram`/`--ctx-checkpoints`
rules.rule: Cap the llama-server `--cache-ram` and `--ctx-checkpoints` flags to limit memory use.

rules.quote: Read the startup log, not the args, to learn the real limit.
rules.rule: To determine the real embedding input limit, read the llm-embeddings server's startup log rather than its command-line arguments.

rules.quote: before changing the embedding model, server args or Honcho chunk size, check `n_ctx_slot` in the llm-embeddings log
rules.rule: Before changing the embedding model, the llm-embeddings server args, or the Honcho chunk size, check the `n_ctx_slot` value in the llm-embeddings startup log.

rules.quote: keep Honcho's limit at most half of it
rules.rule: Keep Honcho's embedding chunk token limit at most half of the `n_ctx_slot` value from the llm-embeddings log.

rules.quote: The server MUST start with `--fabricid 2 --vendorid 4939`
rules.rule: When starting the Matter server, always pass `--fabricid 2 --vendorid 4939`, because without them it ignores the restored fabric.

rules.quote: Never commit the Thread network key/PSKc.
rules.rule: Never commit the Thread network key or PSKc to the repository.

rules.quote: check the static route/firewall first.
rules.rule: If Matter pairing fails again, or the Thread network is re-formed (OMR prefix changes), check the UniFi static route and firewall configuration before anything else.

rules.quote: Set the web server **base_url** to the public https URL
rules.rule: Set the Music Assistant web server base_url to the public https URL, not auto.

rules.quote: Never set the web server **bind_port**
rules.rule: Never set the Music Assistant web server bind_port.

rules.quote: Stream server `bind_ip` must be 192.168.48.62
rules.rule: Set the Music Assistant stream server bind_ip to 192.168.48.62.

rules.quote: Never edit `/data/settings.json` while MA runs.
rules.rule: Never edit /data/settings.json in Music Assistant while MA is running.

rules.quote: Change provider settings in the UI.
rules.rule: Change Music Assistant provider settings through the UI, not by editing files.

rules.quote: `python3 -c` inside the pod
rules.rule: To read a stored Music Assistant value without printing secrets, run python3 -c inside the pod.

rules.quote: decrypt `setup_data.url` only.
rules.rule: When reading a stored Music Assistant value without printing secrets, decrypt only setup_data.url.

rules.quote: `kubectl scale` and patching the Application's `selfHeal` do not stick
rules.rule: Do not pause llama-server by running kubectl scale or by patching the Application's selfHeal setting; pause it through git instead.

rules.quote: Pause through git.
rules.rule: To pause llama-server before a GPU experiment on nv1, make the change through git rather than through live cluster edits.

rules.quote: PR: `cluster/apps/ai/llm/server/values.yaml` `server.replicaCount: 0`, marked TEMPORARY.
rules.rule: To pause llama-server, open a PR setting `server.replicaCount: 0` in `cluster/apps/ai/llm/server/values.yaml`, marked TEMPORARY.

rules.quote: Merge, then `kubectl -n argocd annotate application llm-server argocd.argoproj.io/refresh=hard --overwrite`
rules.rule: After merging the pause PR, run `kubectl -n argocd annotate application llm-server argocd.argoproj.io/refresh=hard --overwrite` to force an Argo CD refresh.

rules.quote: Mount the parent directory: a `type: Directory` check on a subdirectory failed with "is not a directory".
rules.rule: When mounting models into the GPU test pod, mount the parent directory rather than a subdirectory, because a type: Directory hostPath check on a subdirectory fails.

rules.quote: Revert PR (`replicaCount: 1`) right away
rules.rule: Immediately after the GPU experiment, open and merge a revert PR setting `replicaCount: 1` to restore llama-server.

rules.quote: delete the namespace and wipe the hostPath with a one-shot pod.
rules.rule: After the GPU test, delete the test namespace and wipe the hostPath using a one-shot pod.

rules.quote: so warn the user and have the revert PR ready before starting
rules.rule: Before starting the nv1 GPU pause sequence, warn the user about the 30-40 minute llama-server downtime and have the revert PR ready.

rules.quote: if GPU allocatable drops to 0 again, check `talosctl -n 192.168.48.5 get addresses` for a second address
rules.rule: When GPU allocatable on nv1 drops to 0, check `talosctl -n 192.168.48.5 get addresses` for a second address before restarting the Jetson device plugin.

rules.quote: and `dmesg` for kubelet restarts before restarting the plugin
rules.rule: When GPU allocatable on nv1 drops to 0, check `dmesg` for kubelet restarts before restarting the Jetson device plugin.

rules.quote: New media consumers mount `/media` with a `subPath`
rules.rule: When adding a new media consumer, mount the `/media` share with a `subPath` rather than mounting a separate share.

rules.quote: never re-split into separate shares
rules.rule: Never split the `/media` share into separate shares.

rules.quote: subPath directories must pre-exist owned by 1001
rules.rule: Before mounting a `subPath`, make sure its directory already exists and is owned by uid 1001.

rules.quote: Move or copy data with a throwaway root pod that mounts the shares
rules.rule: To move or copy data on the `/media` share, use a throwaway root pod that mounts the shares, because File Station cannot write there as an ordinary user.

rules.quote: then chown 1001:1001
rules.rule: After moving or copying data onto the `/media` share, run chown 1001:1001 on it.

rules.quote: Do not use busybox `cp -n` on a directory that already exists
rules.rule: Do not use busybox `cp -n` to copy into a directory that already exists, because it silently copies nothing.

rules.quote: add the Jellyfin Connect entry in Sonarr/Radarr
rules.rule: After other NFS clients change the media files, add the Jellyfin Connect entry in Sonarr/Radarr so Jellyfin sees the changes.

rules.quote: or run a library scan
rules.rule: After other NFS clients change the media files, run a Jellyfin library scan if you do not add the Connect entry in Sonarr/Radarr.

rules.quote: Add to every CNPG `ObjectStore` via `instanceSidecarConfiguration.env` in `values.yaml`:
rules.rule: Add the checksum environment variables to every CNPG ObjectStore via instanceSidecarConfiguration.env in values.yaml.

rules.quote:
name: AWS_REQUEST_CHECKSUM_CALCULATION
      value: when_required
rules.rule: Set the environment variable AWS_REQUEST_CHECKSUM_CALCULATION to when_required in the instanceSidecarConfiguration.env list.

rules.quote:
name: AWS_RESPONSE_CHECKSUM_VALIDATION
      value: when_required
rules.rule: Set the environment variable AWS_RESPONSE_CHECKSUM_VALIDATION to when_required in the instanceSidecarConfiguration.env list.

rules.quote: The `instanceSidecarConfiguration` key is a top-level sibling of `objectStore:` under `pgsql-cnpg:` in each app's `values.yaml`.
rules.rule: Place the instanceSidecarConfiguration key as a top-level sibling of objectStore under pgsql-cnpg in each app's values.yaml.

rules.quote: do not propose a Qwen3.6/3.8 swap on nv1
rules.rule: On nv1, do not propose swapping in a Qwen3.6 or Qwen3.8 model.

rules.quote: The test pods can share the Service by carrying `app: llama-server` and the PVC
rules.rule: When creating test pods on nv1, you may give them the label `app: llama-server` and the PVC so they share the existing Service.

rules.quote: Pause procedure for a retest: [[reference_nv1_gpu_test_pause]]
rules.rule: For a retest on nv1, follow the pause procedure in reference_nv1_gpu_test_pause.

rules.quote: UDP, not TCP.
rules.rule: Ship Talos service and kernel logs to the Alloy receiver over UDP, not TCP.

rules.quote: UDP is `loki.source.syslog` with `protocol = "udp"` and `syslog_format = "raw"`
rules.rule: For UDP log ingestion in Alloy, use the `loki.source.syslog` component with `protocol = "udp"` and `syslog_format = "raw"`.

rules.quote: needs `stabilityLevel: experimental`
rules.rule: Enable the experimental stability level when using the raw UDP syslog component in Alloy.

rules.quote: use `kubectl exec -i deploy/alloy-talos-logs -c alloy -- sh -c 'cat > /tmp/t.alloy && alloy validate --stability.level=experimental /tmp/t.alloy'` to check component names too
rules.rule: To validate an Alloy config including component names, run `alloy validate --stability.level=experimental` inside the alloy-talos-logs pod via kubectl exec, not just `alloy fmt`.

rules.quote: Alloy object fields need commas
rules.rule: Separate fields in Alloy object expressions with commas, but do not put commas between block attributes.

rules.quote: check the pod logs for `config reloaded` and the live output, not just ArgoCD.
rules.rule: After changing Alloy config, verify the reload by checking the pod logs for `config reloaded` and the live output, not only ArgoCD sync status.

rules.quote: Use distinct numbers.
rules.rule: Give each port in a Service or container port list a distinct number, never repeating a port number across protocols.

rules.quote: check `talosctl netstat` for the UDP flow
rules.rule: When a node's kernel log stream is empty, check `talosctl netstat` for the UDP flow before concluding the port is broken.

rules.quote: query `{source=~"talos-.*", node="nv1"}` after a reboot or upgrade
rules.rule: After a reboot or upgrade of nv1, query Loki with `{source=~"talos-.*", node="nv1"}` to retrieve its logs.

rules.quote: capture the next nv1 upgrade this way
rules.rule: Capture the next nv1 upgrade's logs using the Loki query `{source=~"talos-.*", node="nv1"}`.

rules.quote: using admin credentials, not the kubelet's
rules.rule: When changing a taint on an already-registered worker node, run the kubectl taint commands with admin credentials, not the kubelet's credentials.

rules.quote: kubectl taint nodes <node> <key>=<value>:<effect>   # add the new one
rules.rule: When changing a taint on an already-registered worker node, add the new taint with `kubectl taint nodes <node> <key>=<value>:<effect>`.

rules.quote: kubectl taint nodes <node> <oldkey>-   # remove any stale one
rules.rule: When changing a taint on an already-registered worker node, remove any stale old taint with `kubectl taint nodes <node> <oldkey>-`.

rules.quote: do not plan recurring manual intervention.
rules.rule: Do not plan recurring manual intervention for taint drift on Talos-managed nodes once the taint has been adopted.

rules.quote: Widen tolerations to cover both old and new taint *before* renaming
rules.rule: Before renaming a node taint, widen pod tolerations to cover both the old and the new taint.

rules.quote: then narrow afterwards
rules.rule: After a node taint rename is complete, narrow pod tolerations back to cover only the new taint.

rules.quote: Verify with `kubectl get node <n> -o jsonpath='{.spec.taints}'`
rules.rule: Verify node taints by running `kubectl get node <n> -o jsonpath='{.spec.taints}'`.

rules.quote: Never assume the config was applied.
rules.rule: Never assume a Talos config taint change was applied to a node; verify it on the node.

rules.quote: set `false` in `patches/all/65-security-profile.yaml`
rules.rule: To turn off workload isolation (workloadIsolation) for a Talos node, set it to false in patches/all/65-security-profile.yaml.

rules.quote: repeat the procedure per node
rules.rule: When switching workload isolation on or off, repeat the per-node rollout procedure for each node: apply, cordon, drain, reboot, uncordon, task talos:node_health, scripts/isolation-check.sh, RBD and NFS test pods, then the red test.

rules.quote: Secret read access in `tuppr` means Talos control.
rules.rule: Do not grant or use read access to Secrets in the tuppr namespace without recognizing it grants Talos control, since tuppr-talosconfig holds an os:admin credential.

rules.quote: Pre-hooks suppress the inter-batch health checks, so the health gate uses `healthChecks` only, no hooks.
rules.rule: Do not add pre-hooks to tuppr upgrade configurations; use only `healthChecks` for the health gate.

rules.quote: `Failed` is terminal until the `tuppr.home-operations.com/reset` annotation or a spec edit.
rules.rule: When a tuppr run is Failed, do not expect it to recover on its own; reset it with the `tuppr.home-operations.com/reset` annotation or a spec edit.

rules.quote: nv1's install image in git is the alias tag `custom-installer-jp7:v<talos>`
rules.rule: Keep nv1's install image in git as the alias tag `custom-installer-jp7:v<talos>` and do not replace it with a compound tag.

rules.quote: must be public
rules.rule: Ensure the custom-installer-jp7 image repository is public.

rules.quote: A compound tag in git would leave `task talos:diff` dirty
rules.rule: Do not commit a compound tag for nv1's installer image in git, because it leaves `task talos:diff` dirty.

rules.quote: Ask for the node-lifecycle commands to be allowed up front
rules.rule: Ask the user to allow node-lifecycle commands (such as pod deletion and talosctl reboot) up front rather than attempting them without permission.

rules.quote: before touching the CRs, the Talos API access document or nv1's installer image, and when planning any nv1 upgrade
rules.rule: Consult the tuppr reference before touching the tuppr CRs, the Talos API access document, or nv1's installer image, and before planning any nv1 upgrade.

rules.quote: when comparing embeddings across engines, compare on lowercased input first
rules.rule: When comparing embeddings across engines, compare on lowercased input first.

rules.quote: do not re-embed stored vectors just because a cross-engine check on mixed-case text falls below 0.999
rules.rule: Do not re-embed stored vectors just because a cross-engine check on mixed-case text falls below 0.999.
